teaching_promise: The viewer can trace one information use from affected parties and purpose through minimization, flow and derivative mapping, rights state, residual ownership, and a bounded handoff without mistaking access control, consent, a privacy label, or one deletion for complete rights compliance.

story.concrete_case: A synthetic information-use transaction moves from affected parties and declared purpose through a less-data alternative, mapped context/memory/training/inference/output flows, rights remedy, residual copies and influence, and a bounded successor handoff.
story.opening_question: When authorized access is technically possible, what makes an information use compatible with purpose, minimization, privacy, rights, and complete-enough propagation?
story.payoff: A prospectively frozen information-use record keeps purpose, authority, data, flow, rights, residuals, cost, and evidence ceiling visible, then admits only a bounded receipt.
story.transfer: Carry the rights and flow ledger into Confidential and Verifiable AI Computation, where users, providers, and auditors cross distrust boundaries.

art_direction.visual_thesis: Privacy governance is a purpose-bound information-flow contract with explicit residuals and rights remedies, not an access badge or deletion checkbox.
art_direction.signature_image: A dark rights-governance desk routes one information packet through a purpose contract, less-data filter, flow map, rights ledger, and evidence airlock while copies and influence remain visible.
art_direction.visual_world: A rights-and-flow control room with an affected-party register, purpose contract, minimization sieve, lifecycle flow map, rights/remedy ledger, residual vault, and bounded handoff airlock.
art_direction.composition_rule: Keep the packet center, affected parties and purpose above, flow lanes across the middle, rights and residuals right, and the evidence ceiling anchored at the bottom.
art_direction.palette_rule: Blue marks identity and flow, amber marks purpose and authority, green marks admitted/minimized data, red marks drift/leakage/residuals, violet marks remedies and privacy controls, and gray marks unknown scope; every color is labeled.
art_direction.typography_rule: Use compact uppercase labels for subject, purpose, authority, field, flow, rights, remedy, retention, residual, influence, and support boundary; narration supplies the legal and technical meaning.
art_direction.motion_character: Parties register, purpose binds, fields fall through a minimization sieve, flows branch, rights remedies route failures, residual copies stay in view, and a bounded receipt crosses the airlock.
art_direction.camera_rule: Open on the authorized-use paradox, tighten on purpose and minimization, widen across lifecycle flows and rights state, then return to the evidence ceiling and successor handoff.
art_direction.surface_rule: Every panel names an affected party, purpose, authority, data field, flow, right, remedy, retention, residual, influence, cost, or evidence boundary; unknown routes remain visible.
art_direction.ending_image: A finite information-use receipt seals while a confidential-computation boundary opens beyond the airlock.

audio_direction.narration_style: Concrete, calm, and rights-specific; the information-use record carries the causal arc.
audio_direction.pacing_arc: Open with authorized-use failure, construct purpose and minimization, map flows and remedies, name residual/influence boundaries, then hand off without promotion.
audio_direction.duration_rationale: The 04:20.280 runtime stays below the six-minute soft target while preserving purpose, field selection, flow, rights, residual, and evidence distinctions; six minutes is a soft target, not a hard constraint.
audio_direction.music_policy: No music; packet movement, ledger updates, and airlock closure carry the rhythm.
audio_direction.sound_effect_policy: No sound effects; labels, arrows, boundaries, crosses, and registers encode meaning.

accessibility.color_redundancy: Every data flow and outcome uses labels, enclosure, position, arrow direction, line style, or crosses in addition to color.
accessibility.motion_redundancy: Every route settles into a named state; the rights ledger, residual vault, and evidence boundary remain legible when motion is reduced.
accessibility.integrated_description: The adjacent transcript names affected parties, purpose, minimization, lifecycle flows, rights/remedies, residuals, influence, and evidence boundaries.
accessibility.caption_plan: Use exact receipt-derived cues from the pinned 17-segment narration; the adjacent transcript describes each material state change.
accessibility.reduced_motion_assessment: No flash, spin, shake, or continuous camera drift; flow and rights relations survive pause and reduced motion.

beats.narration: Authorized access can coexist with a rights failure: collection, linkage, inference, memory, training, sharing, retention, and derivatives can violate purpose, minimization, privacy expectations, or executable rights even when confidentiality holds.
beats.sync_anchor: authorized access can coexist with a rights failure
beats.visual_purpose: Expose the authorized-use paradox before showing a control.
beats.visual_action: Place a permission badge over a central information packet, then fan collection, linkage, inference, memory, training, sharing, retention, and derivative paths toward affected parties and rights boundaries.
beats.attention_target: The red rights boundary despite a green access badge.
beats.composition: Packet center; access badge above; flow paths and affected parties around it.
beats.motion_curve: Progressive reveal with a settled paradox.
beats.camera_action: Widen from access badge to full information-flow surface.
beats.hold_purpose: Make authorized access visibly different from compatible use.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative flow surface; no prevalence claim.

beats.narration: Access control, consent language, a differential-privacy label, a low attack rate, one deleted row, a changed answer, or a closed rights ticket cannot by itself establish compatible purpose, privacy, complete propagation, legal compliance, or total forgetting.
beats.visual_purpose: Reject familiar badges and local fixes as complete rights evidence.
beats.visual_action: Stack access, consent, DP, attack-rate, deleted-row, changed-answer, and closed-ticket badges beside a coverage boundary; cross each shortcut where downstream copies and influence remain.
beats.attention_target: The unclosed propagation lanes below the shortcuts.
beats.composition: Shortcuts left; downstream copies and influence right beyond a red boundary.
beats.motion_curve: Tempting stack followed by a hard stop.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on deleted row versus residual copies.
beats.hold_purpose: Show why local fixes cannot close global flow claims.

beats.narration: Bounded execution starts with a prospective information-use record: it binds affected parties, exact purpose and processing, claimed authority and jurisdiction, recipients, retention, minimization, and complete-enough flow through derivatives.
beats.visual_purpose: Construct the information-use contract before execution.
beats.visual_action: Populate an amber purpose contract with affected parties, exact processing, authority, jurisdiction, recipients, retention, minimization, flow, and derivative fields before the packet enters the execution lane.
beats.attention_target: Purpose, authority, and recipients binding before data movement.
beats.composition: Contract above packet; execution gate remains closed.
beats.camera_action: Track contract fields across the header.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the declaration prospective rather than retrospective.
beats.evidence_boundary: A contract schema does not prove compliance.

beats.narration: cross-user boundaries, privacy unit, adjacency, accountant and budget where applicable, threat model and attack plan, rights state and remedy, exceptions, residual copies and influence, costs, and non-authorities; no individual control or receipt alone establishes privacy, legal compliance,
beats.visual_purpose: Complete the contract with privacy, rights, residual, and non-authority fields.
beats.visual_action: Extend the contract with cross-user boundaries, privacy unit, adjacency, accountant/budget, threat plan, rights state, remedy, exceptions, residual copies, influence, cost, and non-authority rows; cross a lone-control shortcut.
beats.attention_target: Residual copies and influence beside the privacy budget.
beats.composition: Privacy fields center; residual and non-authority rows anchored right.
beats.motion_curve: Ledger expansion and firm non-authority cross.
beats.camera_action: Widen to show the whole contract.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep privacy and rights dimensions separate from a single receipt.
beats.evidence_boundary: Fields are design requirements, not legal proof.

beats.narration: total erasure, behavioral forgetting, influence removal, support, readiness, release, transfer, or SOTA. Name subjects, affected groups, and unknown-identity routes. Bind exact purpose, operation, claimed authority, jurisdiction, recipients, retention, expiry, and objection state.
beats.visual_purpose: Freeze identity, purpose, expiry, and objection state while refusing overclaim.
beats.visual_action: Register subjects, affected groups, and unknown routes; lock purpose, operation, authority, jurisdiction, recipients, retention, expiry, and objection state into the contract while broad outcome badges remain outside.
beats.attention_target: Unknown identities and expiry beside the purpose lock.
beats.composition: Register left; contract center; unsupported broad outcomes outside.
beats.motion_curve: Register then lock then boundary reveal.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on expiry and objection state.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent silent scope changes and identity laundering.
beats.evidence_boundary: Frozen scope is necessary, not total forgetting evidence.

beats.narration: A concrete implementation trace makes the proposal testable.
beats.visual_purpose: Move from contract to a bounded test trace.
beats.visual_action: Open a synthetic lifecycle lane from the frozen contract into a contained test harness while keeping execution authority visibly gated.
beats.composition: Contract left; harness center; broad release lane closed.
beats.hold_purpose: Show a test surface without claiming deployment.

beats.narration: Build a synthetic lifecycle transaction and then a prospectively frozen natural small-model/memory campaign comparing ordinary, access-only, minimization, DP, purpose-bound, and competent remediation arms under strong positive-controlled attacks, complete descendant rights workflows,
beats.visual_purpose: Set up positive controls and comparison arms rather than a single demo.
beats.visual_action: Split the harness into ordinary, access-only, minimization, DP, purpose-bound, and competent-remediation arms; attach a natural small-model/memory campaign, descendant workflow, and positive-control attack lanes.
beats.attention_target: Comparison arms and descendant rights workflow.
beats.composition: Arms across center; attack and descendant lanes below.
beats.hold_purpose: Make comparison and positive controls explicit.
beats.evidence_boundary: Plan for a campaign; no result yet.

beats.narration: at least three seeds, independent evaluation, and joint utility/privacy/rights/cost outcomes. Bind exact purpose, operation, claimed authority, jurisdiction, recipients, retention, expiry, and objection state. Test a less-data alternative and admit only necessary fields and granularity.
beats.visual_purpose: Make seeds, independence, joint outcomes, and less-data admission visible.
beats.visual_action: Add three seed tokens and an independent evaluator; route utility, privacy, rights, and cost rows into one ledger, then pass only necessary fields through a less-data sieve.
beats.attention_target: Fields rejected by the sieve and joint outcome rows.
beats.object_after: Independent joint-outcome ledger and minimized packet
beats.composition: Seeds/evaluator left; sieve center; joint ledger right.
beats.motion_curve: Parallel controls followed by selective admission.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on rejected fields, then widen to outcomes.
beats.hold_purpose: Make minimization an observed choice, not a label.
beats.evidence_boundary: A test design does not establish privacy or legal compliance.

beats.narration: Map context, memory, training, inference, output, audit, sharing, cache, backup, checkpoint, and derivative flows while retaining unknowns. Throughout the trace, one invariant remains visible: access is not consent or purpose
beats.sync_anchor: access is not consent or purpose
beats.visual_purpose: Map every lifecycle surface and keep unknowns visible.
beats.visual_action: Draw labeled flow lanes from context and memory through training, inference, output, audit, sharing, cache, backup, checkpoint, and derivatives; leave unknown routes as gray open nodes and separate access from consent/purpose.
beats.attention_target: The gray unknown routes and the access/consent/purpose separation.
beats.composition: Packet center; lifecycle lanes radiate; unknown nodes remain gray.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep propagation and unknowns in the same frame.
beats.evidence_boundary: A map does not prove complete propagation.

beats.narration: The design can still fail. purpose drift consent laundering minimization theater cross-user leakage The correct response is to stop, narrow, quarantine, compensate, or retain an owned residual rather than narrate uncertainty away.
beats.visual_purpose: Route privacy and rights failures to typed remedies.
beats.visual_action: Send purpose drift, consent laundering, minimization theater, and cross-user leakage tokens into stop, narrow, quarantine, compensate, and owned-residual terminals with an accountable owner.
beats.attention_target: The owned residual terminal and remedy owner.
beats.composition: Failure tokens left; remedy fan right; residual owner below.
beats.motion_curve: Many failures converge, then branch to remedies.

beats.narration: This chapter remains Design rationale at argument support. Its contracts, examples, tests, or local artifacts establish only their encoded scope. The chapter names proof targets rather than pretending they are already closed.
beats.visual_purpose: Place the rights proposal at its evidence ceiling.
beats.visual_action: Stamp DESIGN RATIONALE / ARGUMENT SUPPORT over the local contract, flow map, and remedies while proof targets remain open beyond a double boundary.
beats.attention_target: The support stamp and open proof targets.
beats.object_after: Narrow support state with open proof targets
beats.composition: Local artifacts left; open proof targets beyond right boundary.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent the visual derivative from promoting a rights claim.

beats.narration: An accepted finite information use requires matching purpose and authority, minimization, complete-enough flow, and competent privacy evaluation. An accepted bounded receipt preserves storage, behavior, influence, privacy, and legal-compliance separation and refuses authority laundering.
beats.visual_purpose: Show the acceptance checklist and separation of distinct outcomes.
beats.visual_action: Populate an acceptance airlock with purpose/authority match, minimization, complete-enough flow, and competent evaluation; keep storage, behavior, influence, privacy, and legal-compliance rows separate and cross authority laundering.
beats.composition: Checklist center; separated outcome rows right; blocked laundering exit.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on separation rows, then widen to airlock.
beats.evidence_boundary: A checklist is not legal or deployment proof.

beats.visual_purpose: Make the minimization decision explicit as the local payoff.
beats.visual_action: Show a full packet beside a smaller admitted packet; cross unused fields and mark the smaller packet as the admitted candidate.
beats.attention_target: Rejected fields falling outside the admitted packet.
beats.composition: Full packet left; sieve center; minimized packet right.
beats.hold_purpose: Make minimization observable in one glance.
beats.evidence_boundary: A less-data choice is not complete privacy proof.

beats.narration: No chapter claim or evidence state is promoted by this visual. A named mechanism is not proof of correct implementation or useful deployment. A local check or formal model does not establish real-world enforcement. No safety, transfer, state-of-the-art, AGI, or ASI conclusion follows.
beats.visual_purpose: Prevent media from laundering a rights ledger into broad claims.
beats.visual_action: Keep the local information-use record inside a media boundary; cross implementation, useful deployment, enforcement, safety, transfer, frontier, AGI, and ASI exits outside.
beats.attention_target: The stop bar between local rights evidence and broad outcomes.
beats.composition: Ledger left; broad claims right beyond dashed boundary.

beats.narration: These boundaries matter because an explanatory derivative is useful only if it preserves the evidence ceiling of its source.
beats.visual_purpose: Align the live chapter and derivative at one support ceiling.
beats.visual_action: Connect the live chapter card and visual rights ledger with a shared evidence-ceiling line that stays below every broad-claim badge.
beats.composition: Live source left; derivative center; shared ceiling below.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on the shared evidence label.
beats.hold_purpose: Make evidence fidelity a visible requirement.
beats.evidence_boundary: Derivative fidelity does not increase support.

beats.narration: At most, this visual explains the chapter's design rationale at argument support; it adds no empirical, deployment, safety, transfer, state-of-the-art, AGI, or ASI result. The next chapter is Confidential and Verifiable AI Computation.
beats.visual_purpose: State the maximum justified inference and open the successor boundary.
beats.visual_action: Stamp DESIGN RATIONALE / ARGUMENT SUPPORT, fan red nonclaim arrows to broad outcomes, and open a confidential-computation panel beyond the airlock.
beats.attention_target: The narrow support stamp and successor panel.
beats.object_after: Narrow support projection and successor boundary
beats.composition: Support stamp center-left; nonclaims right; successor panel beyond dashed boundary.
beats.motion_curve: One-by-one denial followed by forward handoff.
beats.camera_action: Widen from support stamp to successor panel.
beats.hold_purpose: Close the chapter at its actual evidence ceiling.

beats.narration: It takes responsibility for AI computation increasingly crosses distrust boundaries: a user may need to hide inputs, a provider may need to protect weights, an auditor may need to verify the executed artifact.
beats.visual_purpose: Hand rights and flow governance to confidential and verifiable computation.
beats.visual_action: Seal the finite information-use receipt and open user-input, provider-weight, and auditor-verification lanes beyond a distrust boundary.
beats.attention_target: The three successor trust roles beyond the airlock.
beats.composition: Receipt left; user/provider/auditor panels right beyond dashed boundary.
beats.motion_curve: Forward handoff with settled trust boundary.
beats.camera_action: Widen from receipt to successor trust lanes.
beats.hold_purpose: Close privacy scope without transferring its evidence.
